name: inline-in-text
note: An inline-block badge sits on the same line as the surrounding text: it is shrink-to-fit sized (padding + its text), baseline-aligned with the line (its last line box's baseline matches the surrounding text baseline), and the text continues after it with the intervening whitespace respected. Layer-3 compares the badge border box and the text spans against Chrome; layer-4 compares the badge background strictly (only the text spans are under the text tier).
